final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxx / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON CAST(s.arcref AS TEXT) = CAST(p.arcregistry AS TEXT) GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), step2 AS (SELECT fundflux, AVG(avg_ratio) AS fund_avg FROM step1 GROUP BY fundflux) SELECT step1.arcref, step1.fundflux, step1.avg_ratio, step1.avg_ratio - step2.fund_avg AS difference FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON CAST(step1.fundflux AS TEXT) = CAST(step2.fundflux AS TEXT) WHERE step1.avg_ratio > step2.fund_avg ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
